name.full: Lord Robert Crosby of Holme Hall "C"

place.raw: Holme On Spaulding Moor, Yorkshire, England

notes: TITLE UNSUPPORTED (research 2026-07-03): no source found gives this man a peerage; he appears in records as untitled Yorkshire gentry — "Lord" should be dropped. Also, per line-crosby.md and fragments-01.md research, his documented children (with wife Constance Brigham) were daughters who emigrated to Rowley, MA by 1643, not a son "John Crosby" who stayed in Yorkshire and fathered Richard Crosby (I182620315063) — the export's link from this couple down to John Crosby (I182620315134) is very likely a false merge with an unrelated family. Sources: WikiTree Brigham-88; Find a Grave #38453033.

DEATH YEAR LIKELY WRONG (research 2026-07-03): the export's death "Abt. 1649" is not supported by independent compiled sources — WikiTree gives 1596–1636, and Miner Descent gives ca. 1640 or "before 1642"; no source found supports 1649. The two external sources disagree with each other, so the correct year is unresolved, but 1649 appears wrong either way. Sources: WikiTree Crosby-163; Geni: Robert Crosby of Holme Hall; Miner Descent (minerdescent.com/2010/06/29/robert-crosby).
